source_snapshot.items: All SAS/SATA NVMe LED Check - Access /Busy
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert NVMe SSD into the backplane and check the Access/Busy LED.
source_snapshot.criteria: LED behavior matches the system specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL substitutes Locate/raw IPMI indicator control for genuine storage activity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires literal NVMe Access/Busy semantics, a data-safe I/O stimulus, stable target mapping and physical evidence.

old_problem: SAS/SATA taxonomy obscured an explicit NVMe Access/Busy procedure, and no real I/O stimulus or authoritative LED cadence was supplied; DeepSeek proposed a different Locate/raw indicator.
disposition_reason: The Items suffix and Procedure establish NVMe Access/Busy as the literal test purpose; SAS/SATA is legacy grouping, not an alternate target. The missing SSD mapping, OEM idle/active cadence and bounded safe stimulus are executable project parameters. Locate/raw control is excluded because it does not prove activity indication.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row114 all18 XLSX cells and history2722.
Preserved NVMe insertion plus idle-active-idle Access/Busy observation and required real I/O correlation.
Applied parameterization and physical-evidence rules; no storage I/O, insertion, LED command or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized NVMe idle-active-idle Access/Busy LED validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved NVMe SSD's physical Access/Busy LED follows the OEM-defined idle, active-I/O and return-to-idle behavior for the mapped backplane bay.
required_package: SSD serial/NGUID-to-bay/backplane/controller/BDF/namespace or approved isolated volume mapping
OEM Access/Busy LED color, cadence, latency and return-to-idle specification
Approved bounded read-only device workload or isolated test-file workload, duration and cleanup
Qualified operator, supported insertion method and timestamped physical video
OS/boot/mount/swap/LVM/RAID/data exclusions, health abort limits and recovery policy
test_case.test_command: After approved insertion and stable-identity verification, capture an idle baseline, run only the authorized bounded read-only or isolated test-file I/O against the exact mapped NVMe target, and capture controller/OS I/O counters synchronized with physical Access/Busy LED video through return to idle. Do not use Locate, undocumented raw LED commands, an unverified device name or unrestricted writes.
test_case.expected_result: The exact mapped NVMe remains healthy and its physical Access/Busy LED shows the OEM-specified idle-active-idle state and timing correlated to the authorized workload, with no unexpected storage or platform errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires stable target identity, completed safe workload, controller/OS activity evidence and genuine timestamp-correlated physical LED behavior matching the approved OEM table. Locate/raw toggles or an uncorrelated blink cannot pass.
safety_gate: Protect OS, boot, EFI, mounted uncontrolled, swap, LVM, RAID and valuable-data targets.
Physical insertion is qualified-operator work using approved power/hot-swap and ESD controls.
Pin the stable SSD/volume identity and verify the workload cannot escape its approved boundary.
Abort on identity drift, wrong-bay activity, media/controller/filesystem/thermal/power error or lost recovery; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: OEM Access/Busy state/cadence/timing table and insertion/workload authorization
Exact workload command/target/PID, exit, byte count and cleanup
Controller/OS I/O counters, NVMe health, dmesg/syslog/SEL and final idle topology
test_case.recovery: Stop the workload first; preserve target, process, I/O, health, log and video evidence. If mapping or LED behavior is unexpected, perform no additional I/O or reseat, restore only through the approved storage/backplane procedure, and require the owner to review before another attempt.

source_conflict.reason: Literal NVMe wording and procedure define the hardware target; SAS/SATA is legacy taxonomy. Locate/raw commands are rejected as non-equivalent rather than treated as a competing source requirement.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; OEM cadence, stable mapping, safe workload and operator evidence gate execution.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind the exact NVMe topology, OEM Access/Busy matrix, safe workload/data boundary, operator and recovery.
pending.unlock_condition: No Engineering Decision remains; missing OEM/mapping/workload inputs prevent execution or PASS.

project_authority: OEM LED semantics, topology and approved I/O boundary remain project-controlled inputs.
